questions.question: 1. Time period of a particle executing simple harmonic motion is 4 s and its amplitude is 4 m . The particle will possess half potential energy and half kinetic energy after how much time of passing the equilibrium position?

questions.subject: Physics(10)
questions.question: 2. $6000 \mathrm{MJ}$ of kinetic energy is transferred to an artificial satellite of $200 \mathrm{~kg}$ mass while it is taken to a particular altitude from the earth's surface. At what altitude will the satellite revolve around the earth? The mass of earth is $6 \times 10^{24} \mathrm{~kg}$, radius is $6400 \mathrm{~km}$ and $\mathrm{G}=6.6 \times 10^{-11} \mathrm{Nm}^{2} \mathrm{~kg}^{-2}$.

questions.subject: Physics(10)
questions.question: 5. 2 litre water in a $1.5 \mathrm{~kW}$ electric kettle starts boiling after $6 \mathrm{~min} 20 \mathrm{sec}$. What was the initial temperature of water in the kettle? How many units of electricity were consumed to boil the water in the kettle? (Neglect heat losses).

questions.subject: Physics(10)
questions.question: 6. The refractive index of the material of a prism is 1.5 . If light is incident at $50^{\circ}$ on any plane of the prism, then it has minimum deviation. Calculate the angle of prism.

questions.subject: Physics(10)
questions.question: 7. A long conductor produced a single circular loop of radius, $r=0.15 \mathrm{~m}$ and other parts of this conductor remained straight. Another long conductor is placed parallel at a distance, $\mathrm{d}=0.25 \mathrm{~m}$ from the center of the loop and conducts equal current in opposite direction as shown in the figure. To produce a magnetic field of $4.72 \mu \mathrm{T}$ at the center of the loop, how much current is to be passed in each conductor? $\left[\mu_{0}=4 \pi \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{TmA}^{-1}\right]$[IMG: https://assets.chorcha.net/AIUXasZnQKDhQLRDwjqh4.png]

questions.subject: Physics(10)

questions.subject: Physics(10)
